name: Classic Dual-Player Arcade Cabinet
headline: Commercial dual-player video cabinet for fighting & classic games
description: A heavyweight commercial arcade cabinet designed for two players with joystick + 6-button controls, LED T-molding and an anti-glare screen. Built on open PC-based hardware so game sets can be swapped or customized. This is a sample placeholder product - full spec subject to change.

Master volume & operator service menu with security lock
